label: STUDENT SUMMARY — fictional text written for this game by a fictional student, not a quotation. Facts checked against the Church News, Sept. 11, 1999 ("President Hinckley dedicates new building at Ricks").
facts: The Spencer W. Kimball Building was dedicated on September 7, 1999.
President Gordon B. Hinckley dedicated it and offered the dedicatory prayer.
It is named for Spencer W. Kimball, the 12th President of the Church.
It is at Ricks College in Rexburg, Idaho.
It houses student services (admissions, financial aid) and executive offices.

easy.text: On September 7, 1899, President Gordon B. Hinckley dedicated the new Spencer W. Kimball Building at Ricks College in Rexburg, Utah. The building is named for President Hinckley.
